title: Meal Schema
description: The Meal entity and its request/response payloads: a named meal is an ordered set of food items, each with a role. Also covers the meal enums (type/status/food source/item role), the food-lookup payloads, and the AI-recipe draft payloads driven from the meal flow. Self-contained — no cross-file $ref.

MealType.description: Whether the meal is treated as a full meal or a snack

FoodSource.description: Where a meal item's food record lives. 'food' = Food DB (USDA/brand), 'userfood' = user-owned UserFoods row, 'pending' = looked up on the fly, not yet saved to UserFoods; name is stored for the shopping list, IsTracked is false until resolved

ItemRole.description: Role of the food within a meal — drives shopping list grouping and AI portioning. primary: The anchor of the meal — main protein or star ingredient. secondary: Supporting protein or substantial complement to the primary. side: Accompaniment — carb, vegetable, or supporting component. ingredient: Recipe component, not a standalone food (oil, spices, sauces).

MealItem.description: A food item within a meal

isTracked.description: True when the item contributes to macro totals and shopping list

unit.description: Unit of measurement (serving, oz, g, etc.)

productPurchaseLink.description: Optional pre-baked purchase link (e.g., Amazon URL)

Meal.description: A standalone meal with its items

isRegiApproved.description: True when this is an admin-curated, REGI-approved meal visible to all users

isSaved.description: Throwaway flag — false until the user names/saves the meal

servings.description: How many servings this meal yields

MealSummary.description: Lightweight meal info for list views

CreateMealRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/meal — creates an empty named meal

servings.description: How many servings this meal yields (1–100). Defaults to 1.

UpdateMealRequest.description: Request body for PATCH /api/meal/{id} — all fields optional; only provided fields are updated

isSaved.description: Whether the meal is saved to the user's library

prepVideoLink.description: New prep video URL (empty string clears the link)

recipeLink.description: New recipe URL (empty string clears the link)

AddMealItemRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/meal/{id}/items — adds a single food item to a meal

foodId.description: FK into the Food row (food/userfood). Null when foodSource is 'pending'.

isTracked.description: True when the item contributes to macro totals and shopping list. False for ingredients we don't pre-shop.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (serving, oz, g, etc.)

UpdateMealItemRequest.description: Request body for PUT /api/meal/{id}/items/{itemId} — all fields optional

isTracked.description: Whether the item should contribute to macros and shopping list

sortOrder.description: New display order within the meal

FoodLookupRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/food/lookup — searches the food database for an item by name or UPC, optionally adding it to the user's UserFoods if found

query.description: Free-text search query (food name or fragment)

upcCode.description: Optional UPC barcode to look up directly

addIfFound.description: When true, persist the matched food into the user's UserFoods so it can be reused

found.description: True when a match was located

userFoodCreated.description: True when addIfFound was honored and a new UserFoods row was created

userFoodId.description: ID of the UserFoods row created by addIfFound (null when none was created)

item.description: When found, shape matches MealItem from meal.schema.json (foodId, foodName, foodSource, quantity, unit, plus optional macros)

AIRecipeRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/meal/{id}/ai-recipe — asks the AI to draft a recipe shaped around the meal's primary food

primaryFoodName.description: Optional override for the primary food name (defaults to the meal's main item)

maxPrepMinutes.description: Optional cap on combined prep + cook time

servings.description: Optional override for servings the recipe should yield

AIRecipeIngredient.description: One ingredient line in an AI-drafted recipe

quantity.description: Ingredient quantity as free-form text (e.g., '2 cups', '1 tbsp')

recipeId.description: ID of the persisted recipe row

servingsBase.description: Servings the macros and ingredient quantities are based on

source.description: Where the recipe came from (e.g., 'ai', model name)

recipeLink.description: Optional canonical URL to the recipe

appliedToMeal.description: True when the AI-drafted items were also added to the meal (write-through)

itemsAdded.description: How many meal items were created when appliedToMeal is true

GenerateMealRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/meal/generate — AI-generates ONE meal (persisted, isSaved=false) anchored on a protein and avoiding a list of already-made meals. The per-meal primitive the binder fills from; never generates a rotation. Omitted fields are filled server-side from the user's picks/preferences and daily goals.

anchorProtein.description: The protein this meal is built around. When absent, the server falls back to the user's first Proteins pick, else a protein from UserFoodPreferences.

macroTarget.description: Per-meal macro goal the meal should aim for. When absent, the server computes fair-share = DailyGoals ÷ mealsPerDay.

excludeMeals.description: Names or descriptions of meals already generated this session, so the AI produces something different.
